ideas.pitch: An interactive web-based cybersecurity training platform designed to teach secure coding and common web vulnerabilities through guided CTF challenges.
ideas.problem_statement: Crackhunt cybersecurity-based gaming event focusing on problem-solving and security challenges
ideas.title: SecuLearn CTF Academy
ideas.why_it_could_win: Aligns directly with the core educational and problem-solving goals of the ISDF Club event, reminiscent of uOttaHack 5 CSE category winners.

ideas.pitch: A lightweight web security scanner that inspects headers, dependencies, and basic injection vectors on developer applications.
ideas.problem_statement: Crackhunt cybersecurity-based gaming event focusing on problem-solving and security challenges
ideas.title: VulnScan Lite
ideas.why_it_could_win: Leverages the modular website scanning framework approach from National Hackathon winners to provide immediate, tangible utility for security enthusiasts.

ideas.pitch: A Python CLI utility that parses codebases to flag hardcoded secrets, misconfigurations, and outdated vulnerable dependencies.
ideas.problem_statement: Crackhunt cybersecurity-based gaming event focusing on problem-solving and security challenges
ideas.title: RepoSec Audit Tool
ideas.why_it_could_win: Applies the repo-summary and security insights pattern that won Microsoft's Global Intern Hackathon, tailored specifically for CTF and security code audits.

ideas.pitch: A proxy layer designed to sanitize inputs and enforce defense-in-depth principles against prompt injection and injection exploits.
ideas.problem_statement: Crackhunt cybersecurity-based gaming event focusing on problem-solving and security challenges
ideas.title: DefenseGuard Prompt Shield
ideas.why_it_could_win: Mirrors the defense-in-depth architecture of BitGN Personal Agent Challenge winning entries, focusing on robust input validation and hardening.
